meaning: unique identifier; encodes campaign, modality, binder length, backbone hash and ProteinMPNN sequence index
position in the submitted CSV, 1 is highest; empty when the design is not submitted
whether this design appears in the submitted CSV
BindCraft trajectory hash. Two designs sharing it share a backbone and are NOT independent poses
ProteinMPNN sequence index on that backbone (seq0 or seq1). With kept_sequences=2 two sequences are kept per backbone; neither is derived from the other
generation campaign
binder amino-acid sequence; the literal value 'withheld' for designs that are not submitted
number of binder residues
net binder charge
number of cysteines; zero across the whole set, which matters because expression is cell-free and free cysteines are an expression liability
AlphaFold2 interface pTM on scale [0,1]. IN-SAMPLE: BindCraft optimises designs by gradient descent through AlphaFold2, so this is a training score, not a test score
AlphaFold2 interface predicted aligned error on scale [0,1], lower is better. Also in-sample
buried surface area at the interface, square angstroms
fraction of contacts touching the requested hotspots A318, A323, A406, A409
fraction of contacts outside the intended epitope
Boltz-2 interface pTM, mean over three diffusion samples. Boltz-2 never took part in generating these designs

fraction of residue-residue contact pairs of the design model that are recovered in the folding model, best of three samples. Contact means any heavy-atom pair within 5.0 angstroms. Asymmetric on purpose: the question is whether the design pose is recovered, not whether the two poses are identical
the same quantity on the worst of the three samples
whether contact recovery and folding-model iptm both clear their thresholds. These thresholds separate nothing on this set: all 23 candidates clear them, so this column carries no ranking information

interface predicted aligned error score, mean over samples, computed by the reference implementation of its authors at PAE cutoff 10 and distance cutoff 15 angstroms. Unlike iptm it is renormalised on interface residues, so a small binder against a large target is not diluted

the same score in the target-to-binder direction, which is the more demanding of the two for a small binder. Reported alongside the symmetrised value so the choice of the maximum is visible rather than implicit
local interaction score, mean over samples

columns the reference implementation computes but which are not usable from a Boltz-2 input, with the reason for each. ipTM_af reads 0.000 because the tool expects an AlphaFold2 or AlphaFold3 JSON; pDockQ and pDockQ2 are constant across all designs because the Boltz branch does not supply what they need; n0res is the d0 normalisation count, equal to the aligned chain length, and is not a count of interface residues. Verified by reading the raw output rather than assumed

fraction of positions at which ProteinMPNN, resampling the binder on its own design backbone with the target held fixed, reproduces the submitted residue; mean over 8 samples at temperature 0.1. PARTLY CIRCULAR, because BindCraft itself uses ProteinMPNN to generate sequences. It is not fully circular: BindCraft selects sequences after refolding on AlphaFold2 filters rather than on the ProteinMPNN optimum, which is why recovery sits near 0.6 instead of near 1.0
the same quantity on the worst of the samples
one of four tiers: robust mechanism, non-reproducible mechanism, neutral, counter-selective. A mechanism counts as robust only when the pKa shift is positive on all three independent measurements
how many of the available pKa-shift measurements are positive

shift of the pKa of target histidine H409 between bound and unbound target, computed on the AlphaFold2 design model. Positive means binding stabilises the protonated form, so binding is favoured at acidic pH. Negative means the opposite of the objective
the same shift computed on the Boltz-2 model of the same complex. Tests whether the mechanism is a property of the sequence or of one predicted structure
the same shift on the complex with the mouse domain III

predicted ratio of affinity at pH 6.5 over pH 7.4 arising from the H409 pKa shift alone; 1.0 means no selectivity. PROPKA is commonly wrong by about one pKa unit, so this ranks designs and is not claimed as a value
the same ratio taken over every ionisable group in the complex rather than H409 alone, which is the unbiased form of the proton-ligand linkage. It assumes independent sites
binder acidic residue closest to an imidazole nitrogen of H409
distance from that carboxylate to the nearest imidazole nitrogen, angstroms
angle at the accepting oxygen. An sp2 carboxylate points its lone pairs near 120 degrees, so values near 80 or 160 are poor geometries
worst of the two distances in the best pair of TWO DISTINCT binder carboxylates, one on ND1 and one on NE2 of H409. Measured on the design model
the same quantity measured on the Boltz-2 model. The two are reported separately because the rule they support does not survive transferring geometry between predictors
fraction of the human design-model contact pairs recovered when the same binder is predicted against the mouse domain III. Structural measurement of cross-reactivity
Boltz-2 interface pTM against the mouse target
mouse iptm minus human iptm; near zero means binding confidence does not suffer from the change of species
whether a pH mechanism seen on the human target persists on the mouse target
SEQUENCE PROXY: fraction of contacted target residues identical in mouse. Demonstrably insufficient on this set, since it does not separate the designs that change binding mode on the mouse target
contacted target residues that are not identical in mouse
solvent-exposed deamidation motifs; NG strongest, then NS, NT, NN, NA, NH. Buried motifs are counted but not scored, because water does not reach them
provenance: motif scan weighted by side-chain SASA

meaning: solvent-exposed isomerisation motifs; DG strongest, then DS, DT, DD
provenance: motif scan weighted by side-chain SASA

meaning: exposed DP motifs, acid hydrolysis. The assay runs at pH 6.5, closer to the regime where this matters than a neutral assay would be
provenance: motif scan weighted by side-chain SASA

meaning: exposed methionine and tryptophan
provenance: motif scan weighted by side-chain SASA

meaning: sliding windows of 5 residues with at least 4 exposed acidic residues
the same for basic residues
the same for exposed hydrophobic residues
runs of four or more identical consecutive residues

N-X-S/T sequons with X not proline. NOT scored as a liability here, because expression is cell-free and therefore carries no glycosylation machinery. Counted because the motif would become a liability in a eukaryotic system

ESM-2 pseudo log-likelihood per residue, masked marginals, esm2_t33_650M_UR50D. EXCLUDED FROM EVERY ORDERING by construction: it measures resemblance to natural proteins, while the challenge requires novelty, so ranking on it would favour the least novel designs. Read only as an outlier detector, and on this set it flags nothing
